ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $ \triangle ABC$ is inscribed in $ \odot O$, with chords AE and BC intersecting at point D. Line BO is drawn such that $ \angle CAE = \angle ABO$ and $ AE \perp BC$. If $ ED = \sqrt{3} CD$, find the degree measure of $ \angle ABC$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: As shown in the figure, connect CE,\\
$\therefore \angle ABC=\angle AEC$,\\
$\because ED=\sqrt{3}CD$, AE$\perp$BC,\\
$\therefore \tan\angle AEC=\frac{CD}{DE}=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}$,\\
$\therefore \angle AEC=30^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle ABC=\boxed{30^\circ}$;
